notes: Ethanol is oxidised to ethanoic acid.

back: Ethanoic acid, $\ce{CH3COOH}$ (with acidified $\ce{K2Cr2O7}$ or $\ce{KMnO4}$, or by bacteria in air).

front: Why does ethanol boil far higher than propane?
back: Its –OH group makes the forces between molecules much stronger (their masses are similar).

notes: Blending renewable ethanol reduces petrol imports.

front: Why must methylated spirits never be drunk?
back: It contains methanol, which is poisonous and can cause blindness or death.
